atomchat.tutorial.prompt.title: Getting started
atomchat.tutorial.prompt.body: Learn chat and settings one page at a time. Exit at any time and replay from About.
atomchat.tutorial.replay.desc: Replay the tutorial from the beginning
atomchat.tutorial.demo: Tutorial demo · never saved or sent
atomchat.tutorial.type_hint: Type a short message, then press Send
atomchat.tutorial.demo_message: Sample message · click or right-click to quote
atomchat.tutorial.demo_block: Demo player · select to try blocking

atomchat.tutorial.demo_phrase_selected: Selected: Hello! · your real draft is unchanged
atomchat.tutorial.demo_notification: Mention · demo notification; normally opens its conversation
atomchat.tutorial.navigation.title: Meet the navigation bar
atomchat.tutorial.navigation.body: The bottom tabs are Chat, Profile and Settings. Select a tab, then choose Next.
atomchat.tutorial.conversations.title: Conversations and world chat
atomchat.tutorial.conversations.body: Find the public channel and private conversations here. Private chats are kept separately for each player.
atomchat.tutorial.compose.title: Compose and send
atomchat.tutorial.compose.body: Type a message, then press Enter or Send. It stays inside this tutorial.
atomchat.tutorial.message_actions.title: Message actions and quotes
atomchat.tutorial.message_actions.body: Right-click a message and try Quote. The quoted message appears above the input field.
atomchat.tutorial.search_filter.title: Search and filter
atomchat.tutorial.search_filter.body:
Open Tools and choose Search
Type a keyword to find the sample messages
atomchat.tutorial.players_block.title: Players and blocking
atomchat.tutorial.players_block.body:
Right-click the avatar and try Block
The menu also offers whispers and mentions
atomchat.tutorial.profile.title: Your profile
atomchat.tutorial.profile.body: Manage your avatar, banner, signature and avatar style here. Personal-file actions are only introduced.
atomchat.tutorial.expressions.title: Emoji, kaomoji and stickers
atomchat.tutorial.expressions.body: Open expressions and select an emoji or kaomoji. Custom stickers are managed here too.
atomchat.tutorial.images.title: Images and previews
atomchat.tutorial.images.body: Click the sample image to preview it, then try zooming and dragging. Image sending is in the input tools menu.

atomchat.tutorial.quick_phrases.body: Open quick phrases and insert one. Phrase changes made in this tutorial are discarded.

atomchat.tutorial.privacy.body: Manage server content sync, hidden messages, and blocked players

atomchat.tutorial.about.body:

atomchat.admin.template_guide.title: Message template tutorial
atomchat.admin.template_guide.entry: Learn to add a rule and check its result with a sample line.
atomchat.admin.template_guide.create.des: Go to Message Templates and choose Add. Give the rule a name and select public chat, received private messages, or sent private messages.
